key.name: show-privacy-indicators
key.summary: Coloured dots beside the clock and a peek when an app uses the microphone, camera or screen sharing

key.name: screenshot-peek
key.summary: Show a thumbnail when a screenshot is taken

key.name: show-bluetooth
key.summary: Peek when a Bluetooth device connects or disconnects, with its battery level when known

key.name: show-dnd
key.summary: Show a moon beside the clock and a peek while Do Not Disturb is on

key.name: show-battery-warnings
key.summary: Warn when the battery is low or critical, and peek when it finishes charging

key.name: show-keyboard
key.summary: Peek when Caps Lock changes or the keyboard layout is switched

key.name: show-recording
key.summary: Show a red dot and the elapsed time while GNOME's screen recorder runs, with a click on the notch to stop it

key.name: show-audio-route
key.summary: Say Headphones, Speakers and the like when the sound output changes

key.name: open-on-hover
key.summary: Open the notch when the pointer rests on it

key.name: hover-delay
key.summary: How long the pointer must rest on the notch before it opens, in milliseconds

key.name: closed-width
key.summary: Width of the closed notch, in pixels

key.name: size
key.summary: Size of the notch and everything in it, as a multiple of the normal size

key.name: text-size
key.summary: Size of the text in the notch, as a multiple of the normal size

key.name: accent-mode
key.summary: Where the accent colour for chips, toggles and bars comes from: the old colours, the system accent or a custom one

key.name: clock-mode
key.summary: Where the top bar clock goes: inside the notch, moved to the right, or left alone

key.name: replace-osd
key.summary: Show volume and brightness changes in the notch instead of the GNOME popup

key.name: show-battery-activity
key.summary: Show a battery peek when a charger is plugged in or removed

key.name: notifications-in-notch
key.summary: Show new notifications in the notch instead of as GNOME banners

key.name: notification-buttons
key.summary: Show up to two of a notification's own buttons on its peek; pressing one runs that action

key.name: show-downloads
key.summary: Show browser downloads in the notch

key.name: show-visualizer
key.summary: Animate the music bars in the closed notch while something plays

key.name: visualizer-follows-audio
key.summary: Make the music bars follow what is playing, by reading the level of the sound output

key.name: art-colors
key.summary: Take the colour of the bars, the player text and the seek bar from the album art

key.name: art-glow
key.summary: Glow behind the album cover while the track plays

key.name: scroll-titles
key.summary: Scroll song titles that are too long to fit, instead of cutting them short

key.name: custom-accent
key.summary: The accent colour used when accent-mode is custom, as #rrggbb

key.name: gestures
key.summary: Gestures on the notch: swipe down to open, up to close, sideways to change track

key.name: scroll-volume
key.summary: Change the volume with the mouse wheel over the closed notch

key.name: remember-last-tab
key.summary: Open on the last tab used instead of Home

key.name: toggle-notch
key.summary: Shortcut that opens and closes the notch

key.name: show-music-peek
key.summary: Shortcut that shows what is playing

key.name: music-peek
key.summary: Peek out with the track when music starts or the track changes

key.name: media-linger-seconds
key.summary: How long the music stays in the closed notch after pausing, in seconds

key.name: player-buttons
key.summary: The buttons in the player, in order

key.name: hud-in-open-notch
key.summary: Show volume and brightness changes in the open notch's header

key.name: hud-style
key.summary: How a level change shows in the closed notch: the bar beside the icon, or a row under the clock

key.name: timer-modes
key.summary: Show the stopwatch and Pomodoro modes on the Timer tab, beside the countdown

key.name: pomodoro-work-minutes
key.summary: Length of a Pomodoro work phase, in minutes

key.name: pomodoro-break-minutes
key.summary: Length of a Pomodoro break, in minutes

key.name: player-selection
key.summary: Use the preferred player and the ignored players below when choosing which music player the notch shows

key.name: preferred-player
key.summary: Part of the name or bus name of the player the notch follows when it plays; empty for none

key.name: ignored-players
key.summary: Parts of the names or bus names of players the notch ignores, separated by commas

key.name: hud-percentage
key.summary: Show the number next to the level bar

key.name: battery-details
key.summary: Open the battery details when the battery in the header of the open notch is clicked

key.name: power-saver-peek
key.summary: Peek when the power profile changes to or from Power Saver

key.name: hide-all-day-events
key.summary: Leave the all-day events out of the event list in the Today tab

key.name: event-colors
key.summary: Show a bar in each calendar's colour beside its events in the Today tab

key.name: up-next
key.summary: Name the next event today, with its time, on the Home tab when nothing is playing

key.name: show-next-event
key.summary: Count down to the next event in the closed notch while it starts within the lead time

key.name: meeting-lead-minutes
key.summary: How many minutes before an event its countdown starts showing in the closed notch

key.name: show-shelf
key.summary: Show the Shelf tab in the open notch, with the files you pasted, downloaded or captured

key.name: shelf-auto-add
key.summary: Add finished downloads and new screenshots to the shelf

key.name: clipboard-history
key.summary: Read the clipboard whenever something is copied and keep the recent text, in memory only, for the Clipboard list of the Shelf tab

key.name: shelf-share
key.summary: Show a Share button on shelf files, for the sharing targets found on this computer: GSConnect, Bluetooth, LocalSend and email
